description: Provides dual benefits of annual crop investment support and life insurance coverage to farmers and sharecroppers across West Bengal.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000/year (minimum ₹4,000/year for small holdings) in two installments, plus ₹2,00,000 death benefit insurance cover.
eligibility: Landowning farmers and registered sharecroppers (Bargadars) in West Bengal aged 18 to 60 years
documents: RoR / Khatian Copy / Barga Registration Certificate
application_mode: Online via Krishak Bandhu Portal / Duare Sarkar Camps

description: A state-sponsored crop insurance program covering crop loss due to adverse weather events with no premium cost for farmers.
benefits: 100% premium cost borne by the West Bengal government for all notified food and oilseed crops; direct financial compensation for loss.
eligibility: All farmers (owner-cultivators, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers) cultivating notified crops in West Bengal
documents: Sowing Certificate from local Krishi Prajukti Sahayak (KPS)
application_mode: Online via BSB Portal / Block Development Office

description: Offers subsidies for purchasing small equipment, power tillers, and setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) to encourage mechanized farming.
benefits: 50% to 60% subsidy (up to ₹3,00,000) for machinery and up to 40% grant (up to ₹10,00,000) for CHC establishment.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and SHGs registered on the Matir Katha portal

description: Transforms barren and red-laterite soil lands across western districts into productive horticulture and animal husbandry hubs.
benefits: Free distribution of fruit saplings, soil conditioning support, drip irrigation installation, and micro-credit access.
eligibility: Farmers owning underutilized or barren land in Bankura, Purulia, Jhargram, Birbhum, and Paschim Medinipur
application_mode: Offline via Block Development Office (BDO) / Duare Sarkar

description: Provides financial support to build post-harvest storage structures like low-cost grain stores, onion storage units, and seed stores.
benefits: Financial subsidy ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 depending on the type and storage capacity of the structure built.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding registered agricultural land in West Bengal
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) Block Office

description: Promotes rainwater harvesting and farm-pond creation to ensure year-round irrigation availability for agricultural lands.
benefits: 100% state funding or direct assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for digging dedicated farm ponds and water retention tanks.
eligibility: Farmers and landowners in West Bengal with suitable land for pond excavation
application_mode: Offline via Water Resources Investigation & Development Department

description: Facilitates direct sales of farm produce from growers to urban consumers through state-managed retail outlets and mobile vans.
benefits: Direct procurement at fair prices, eliminating middleman commissions; subsidies on mobile vending vehicles for FPOs.
eligibility: Farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in West Bengal
documents: Farmer Registration ID / FPO Registration Certificate
application_mode: Online / Offline via Sufal Bangla Project Management Unit

scheme_name: West Bengal Cattle & Livestock Distribution Scheme
description: Distributes high-yielding milch cows, goats, and poultry to rural farming families to supplement farm income.
benefits: Up to 80% to 100% subsidized distribution of livestock units and free veterinary health support.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and landless agricultural laborers in West Bengal with preference given to women
application_mode: Offline via Block Livestock Development Officer (BLDO)

scheme_name: State Tea Garden Workers & Small Tea Growers Assistance
description: Provides specialized input incentives, green leaf price protection, and equipment support to small tea growers (STGs) in North Bengal.
benefits: Subsidized fertilizers, tea pruning tools, and financial grants for organic certification.
eligibility: Small tea growers holding land up to 10.12 hectares registered with the Tea Board / WB Agri Department
documents: Tea Board / Small Tea Grower Registration
application_mode: Offline via District Agricultural Office (North Bengal Districts)

description: Offers assistance for fish pond re-excavation, supply of high-quality fingerlings, and fish feed to small scale aquaculture farmers.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on input purchases (fish seed/feed) and technical aid for brackish and freshwater fish farming.
eligibility: Fish farmers, fishers' cooperatives, and pond owners/lessees in West Bengal
documents: Pond Ownership Record or Lease Agreement
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Fisheries (ADF) at Block Level
